name: XDKNet 2.5.16
body:
Android TV 2.5.16, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.15 (Emby 2.0.5.15).
Update the plugin too: without it the new Calendar, watch progress and Seerr
poster settings stay on the TV that set them. Everything else works with
2.1.0.14.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

This release is for everyone. Nothing in it needs admin rights.

## Settings that stick

- A setting changed while the last change was still being saved, or whose
  save failed, is no longer put back when the server sends your settings
  back. It is saved again instead.
- A custom theme you picked stays picked when it cannot be downloaded or read
  on one TV; the built-in theme shows meanwhile, and your choice is not
  wiped on your other devices.

## Calendar

- A **Calendar** page lists upcoming episodes and films, opened from a See
  All card at the end of the Upcoming rows or from Settings > Home Screen >
  External Lists > Upcoming Calendars. Pick an agenda or a countdown, the week's first day, episodes,
  films or both, and a spoiler safe mode.
- The Upcoming rows show only what is still to come, and a film out today
  stays in the Radarr row all day.
- At the end of the last episode out, the player says when the next one airs.

## Watching

- A film or episode **reconnects by itself** when the network drops, and
  says so if the connection does not come back.
- Auto quality starts playing straight away instead of waiting for a speed
  test.
- Playback Information shows the TV's HDMI output mode and whether the sound
  goes out as passthrough or decoded.
- Seek previews are ready sooner and stay loaded.
- Styled (ASS) subtitles no longer fill memory or stall busy scenes.
- Dolby Vision profile 5 the server converts no longer plays green and
  purple.

## Live TV

- A channel the server refuses switches to the server's stream at once.
- Channels that list their fast-seek stream first now play with sound.
- The guide no longer shows programmes twice when it loads quickly.

## Home and Requests

- TV Home rows move faster on Up and Down.
- **Hide Watch Progress** in Settings > Home Screen takes the progress bar
  off Home's cards.
- Requests: the status on posters can be turned off or shown as a banner,
  Discover's posters follow your poster size, a genre or keyword can switch
  between films and series, and resolved issues show under All.

## Fixes

- A short OK press stays short on remotes that send an extra key code.
- A Home preview ending late no longer stops the film you just started.
- Theme music carries on when you open a title from a Home row.
- The server screen puts focus on the first server.
- The Storage pickers scroll to every option.
- Setup waits for your own settings before asking anything.
